verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs claim seamless integration with Hugging Face models, support for 200+ Hugging Face model architectures, and a trust-remote-code flag for running Hub models with custom code, so running Hugging Face models is directly supported. The pack never explicitly documents downloading weights from the Hub, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation of downloading or pulling models from the Hugging Face Hub (e.g., by model ID), a hands-on or community confirmation of the download-and-run flow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: Seamless integration with popular Hugging Face models
vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on HuggingFace
on the Hugging Face Model Hub, simply set `trust_remote_code=True` for offline-inference or `--trust-remote-code` for the online serving.
vLLM also supports model implementations that are available in Transformers.
